data.name: Cattofact
data.shortDescription: Replace the artifact with Maxwell or an image of your choice.
data.description:
# Cattofact


By default the artifact will be replaced with Maxwell the cat. 
You can also change it to an image in the settings. Images are stored in `Sons Of The Forest\Mods\Cattofact\Textures` and prefixed with `Slot`. You can then choose the specific texture to use in the settings.



### Bonus Feature


The mod also changes the tattoo on the right arm (the "Fight Demons" tattoo seen in the intro) to a cat. To use a custom tattoo change the `Sons Of The Forest\Mods\Cattofact\Textures\Tattoo.png` texture.
